title: The Man Mama Prayed I'd Be
in_plain_words: The words leave little room. About 6 bars in a hundred have nothing sung; kept songs leave 12 to 28. The song runs 307 seconds over 128 bars, and 116 of those bars belong to sung sections. Fewer lines, or a verse less, would leave room for the voice to rest.

The singing is one busyness all through. The verse's lines run 8.4 syllables and the chorus's 7.5 (close to the same). Kept songs change: a wordy verse against a chorus of few, held words, or the reverse. Lines of clearly different length in verse and chorus would give the tune that change.
